source: Listings come from OpenZeppelin's midnight-apps README and from applications filed in the deployments folder of midnightntwrk/midnight-improvement-proposals, read on 27 September 2026. Summaries are condensed from those texts. Repositories that were not public were left out.

services.name: Lunarswap
services.summary: A proof-of-concept DEX for trading tokens on Midnight, from OpenZeppelin's sample apps.
services.idea: Swap treasury tokens without leaving the wallet, with the same approval rules as any payment.

services.name: Ascend DEX
services.summary: A private spot order book: orders are committed on chain, matched off chain, and settled with checks on price, deposits and fees.
services.idea: Let an agent place limit orders within its spending cap.

services.name: Ascend Perps
services.summary: Perpetual futures with escrowed margin, signed orders and open-interest limits, settled against external chains.
services.idea: Hedging for a treasury, behind a quorum of people.

services.name: Test Tokens for Midnight Intents
services.summary: A minimal contract that mints shielded test tokens, for testing and demoing swaps with Shielded's Midnight Intents.
services.idea: Practice private swaps with play money before real value moves.

services.name: Capacity Exchange
services.summary: An on-chain registry of servers that sponsor transaction fees: operators register and post NIGHT as collateral, and clients find them by reading the ledger.
services.idea: Pay agents' DUST fees through a sponsor, so new agents can act before their own DUST builds up.

services.name: Sponsored transaction demos
services.summary: A counter and a shielded token vault whose calls have their fees paid by the Capacity Exchange.
services.idea: The simplest way to see a fee-sponsored call from a fresh wallet.

services.name: MidnightZK Anchor
services.summary: A multi-tenant platform that anchors data hashes onto Midnight on behalf of enterprise tenants.
services.idea: Anchor the wallet's own audit log, so records of approvals can be proven later.

services.name: Shadow Labz VoteChain
services.summary: Private governance tools: Sybil-resistant polls where eligible members vote once each, proven against a Merkle root.
services.idea: The quorum behind shared control: people and agents voting on a large payment.

services.name: nightforce.cc Directory
services.summary: Public profiles with selective disclosure: each person chooses which fields are visible, with a contact mode kept on chain.
services.idea: A directory of trusted payees to check before an agent pays someone new.

services.name: Provven
services.summary: Proofs of driver qualifications for hiring in trucking: the disclosed fact is public, the underlying report stays off chain.
services.idea: Credentials an agent must hold before it is appointed.

services.name: GYOTAK traceability
services.summary: Provable origin for flash-frozen seafood: catch records, cold-chain temperature logs and anonymous purchase commitments.
services.idea: Pay a supplier only when its shipment's record is on chain.

services.name: VeilCore
services.summary: Proof of prior possession for plant genetics: who held a cultivar and when, with licensing and transfers, and no genetics disclosed.
services.idea: Licences as tokens a treasury can hold and pass on.

services.name: veriphil
services.summary: Proofs of existence and integrity for digital files, anchored on chain.
services.idea: Prove an NFT's artwork existed before it was minted.

services.name: Midnight Private Auction
services.summary: Sealed-bid auctions: bids stay confidential until the deadline, then the winner is revealed on the public ledger.
services.idea: Auction the Gallery's NFTs with bids nobody can see in advance.
